targetText: Given piece-wage, it is naturally the personal interest of the labourer to strain his labour-power as intensely as possible; this enables the capitalist to raise more easily the normal degree of intensity of labour. [8] It is moreover now the personal interest of the labourer to lengthen the working-day, since with it his daily or weekly wages rise.
summary: Self-intensification of exploitation under piece-wages: workers are driven to lengthen their own working day.
explanation: Under piece-work, workers are pressured by low rates to intensify their own effort and work excessive overtime. Once high output becomes normal, the capitalist cuts the piece-rate, compelling workers to produce even more units merely to maintain their original income.

targetText: piece-wage is the form of wages most in harmony with the capitalist mode of production. Although by no means new ; it figures side by side with time-wages officially in the French and English labour statutes of the 14th century ; it only conquers a larger field for action during the period of manufacture, properly so-called.
summary: Piece-wages: the form of wages most in harmony with the capitalist mode of production.
explanation: Piece-wages convert payment into a piece-rate incentive structure. This form allows capital to dispense with extensive supervisory oversight, since workers discipline themselves to maximize output, while quality control is weaponized to make wage deductions.
